column1: # OCR engine swap, measured on the game host 2026-10-27 (spec §14.4).
# engine labels: rec-band = rec-only on ONE text band (spec §14.3's shape);
#   full-panel = the same wheel with detection on, over the whole popup;
#   surya-panel = the pre-swap engine, through the pre-swap call shape.
# surya rows carry text_len=0: RecognitionPredictor on this host does not
#   accept device=, so the old engine could NOT be measured this way — the
#   rows record the failure and its elapsed ms, not a comparison.
# agree_with_human=unverified on every row: a human verdict is not something
# crops all come from C:/temp/ns_popup; 3 text panels x 14 bands each.
